Usage: mcp-vitals [options] [command]

Vital signs for your MCP server: inspect, benchmark latency, and assert health
in CI.

Options:
  -V, --version                           output the version number
  -h, --help                              display help for command

Commands:
  inspect [options] [server...]           discover capabilities, list tools/resources/prompts, validate schemas
  ping [options] [server...]              measure handshake/initialize latency and liveness
  bench [options] [server...]             benchmark tool-call latency: p50/p95/p99, throughput, cold start
  call [options] [server...]              invoke one tool once and print the result + timing
  compare [options] <baseline> [current]  diff two `bench --json` runs and gate on a latency regression
  check [options] [server...]             run a committed mcp-vitals.yaml assertion suite (the CI gate)
  help [command]                          display help for command
